rationale: C24 is a strong reusable template for the child's short government-wide cooperation memorandum. Both address the heads of all executive departments and agencies, briefly identify a newly established investigative or advisory body, and request the fullest possible cooperation and assistance with that body's work. The close wording and matching memorandum-level function are more concrete than the routine cooperation clauses in the commission executive orders. C15 and C10 contain similar government-wide appeals for full cooperation, but their addressees and operative structures are less closely aligned.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Memorandum for the Heads of all Executive Departments and Agencies
shared_material.parent_excerpt: To the Heads of All Executive Departments and Agencies
shared_material.explanation: The directives use essentially the same government-wide memorandum addressee.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I would like all Departments and Agencies to cooperate to the fullest extent in aiding the commission and meeting the requests for assistance which may be made by it.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It is my desire that the Executive branch of the Government cooperate with the Committee to the fullest possible extent. I therefore request that all departments and agencies give Chairman Kefauver and his committee the fullest cooperation and assistance
shared_material.explanation: Both make materially the same operative request: departments and agencies must provide the fullest cooperation and assistance to a newly established investigatory or advisory body.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I HAVE today appointed a temporary commission to formulate recommendations for me concerning the location and use of airports.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Senate Special Crime Investigating Committee has been established to study and investigate whether organized crime utilizes the facilities of interstate commerce
shared_material.explanation: Each memorandum first identifies the body and its assignment, then turns immediately to a government-wide cooperation request.
